name: Dr Neetu Grover
title: MBBS, FRACGP, Adv DRANZCOG, Skin Cancer
bio: Dr Neetu Grover MBBS, FRACGP, Adv DRANZCOG - Senior GP has been providing general medical services for the past 20 years. She lives in Wodonga with her family, raising 3 of her children in the local community and has a passion for Rural General Practice.

name: Dr Ayesha
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr. Ayesha has worked in both General Practice and the hospital setting and enjoys all aspects of General Practice.

name: Dr Joseph
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr. Joseph has years of clinical experience, predominantly in primary care.

name: Dr Sinto Kunjachan
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr Sinto has years of experience in General practice and in Hospital.

name: Dr Bhavin Purohit
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr Bhavin (MD AASC DNB MRCGP) is qualified in India, United Kingdom and United States, and is a highly experienced family medicine doctor and specialist with over 15 years of experience.

name: Dr Lyza Cara
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr Lyza Cara has been working in Wodonga since 2023 and is a warm and experienced General Practitioner who loves caring for people at every stage of life. She values building long-term relationships with her patients and enjoys being part of their health journey — whether it’s helping with day-to-day health concerns or supporting long-term wellness goals.

name: Dr Iby Ann Xavier
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr. Iby is a highly experienced family medicine doctor and specialist with over 12 years of experience.

name: Dr Sonam Topgyal
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr Sonam Topgyal is a Family Physician with over 15 years of clinical experience and a special interest in child health and emergency medicine.

name: Dr Warren
title: General Practitioner
bio: Dr Warren is an experienced doctor with over 15 years of clinical experience. He provides comprehensive general practice care with a strong focus on patient-centred, family-focused medicine.

name: Margi Patel
title: Registered Dietitian
bio: Margi Patel is a passionate and experienced Dietitian providing tailored, evidence-based nutrition care to a wide range of populations. She works collaboratively with individuals to promote nutrition adequacy, independence, and long-term health outcomes. Her approach is person-centred, evidence-based, and non-judgmental, empowering clients to achieve their individual nutrition goals with confidence.
